cost.costSuffix: Plague Monks and Monk Initiates only

specialRules.ruleFull: Warriors within 6" of the Plague Priest may use his Leadership instead of their own.
The Plague Priest is subject to frenzy.
A Plague Champion is subject to frenzy.

fighters.name: Plague Rat
fighters.equipment: None. A Plague Rat fights with teeth and claws.

specialRules.ruleFull: Every attack a Plague Rat makes counts as coated with black lotus.
Plague Rats are animals and gain no experience.

specialSkillsList.name: Cloud of Flies
specialSkillsList.description: A cloud of flies surrounds the warrior. Any model in base contact with him has -1 to hit with every attack. Clan Pestilens Heroes and Plague Monks, undead and followers of Nurgle are not affected.

specialSkillsList.name: Frenzy
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior is subject to frenzy.

rules.name: Fog of Death
rules.summary: A 6 wounds each model in base contact; -1 to hit it when shooting
rules.text: At the end of each close-combat phase roll a D6 for every model in base contact with the wielder. On a 6 that model suffers a wound from the poisonous gas, with no armour save allowed. The wielder is immune to the Fog of Death, even in base contact with another Plague Censer wielder. Shooting at the wielder is at a further -1 to hit.

flags.what: A Clan Pestilens warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported. No henchmen group sizes and no maximum profiles are printed.
The warband spends warp tokens (wt), which the PDF says are treated as gold crowns: every price is imported as gold.
The skill table ticks Priest and Champion Combat, Strength, Speed and Special, and the Initiate Combat, Speed and Special.
The Plague Priest has Movement 4 where every other Skaven of the warband has 5: kept as printed.

The Plague Priest and the Plague Champion "start with the Resilient Strength skill": each starts with our Resilient skill, so neither keeps a rule saying so. The Champion's rule is printed in the Priest's words ("The Plague Priest is a disease-ridden Skaven"), read as the Champion's own.
The Plague Censer is priced 100 wt on the equipment list and 75+5D6 wt, Rare 12, in its own entry: the list price is the starting price and the entry's is the item's price row.

The Plague Censer is its own item, Plague Censer (Mousillon), with the PDF's rules: As user +2, Heavy, Two Handed and a Fog of Death that rolls a D6 for every model in base contact at the end of each close-combat phase (a 6 wounds, no armour save, the wielder immune) and takes -1 to hit when shooting at the wielder. Our Censer (Town Cryer 29) keeps its own Fog of Death, a Toughness test, and is unchanged; this one takes the setting's name, since three warbands are called Skaven of Clan Pestilens (William, 11 Nov 2026).
The equipment lists' Staff (3 gc) and Club/Staff (3 gc) are our Club, Mace or Hammer, bought under the PDF's names.
The Clanrat list's Flail is noted "Plague Monks and Initiates only": read as Plague Monks and Monk Initiates.

The special skills are a new group, Clan Pestilens (Mousillon). Our Skaven Clan Pestilens group (the Mordheim 1b warband's) holds different skills, so the two are kept apart. Resilient is ours. Rotten Body (causes fear) is our Fearsome and Numb is our Ignore Pain: both are merged into ours (William, 12 Nov 2026), so the group learns ours and the PDF's names are dropped. Our own Rotten Body, which makes a Skaven immune to poisons, diseases and the fog of death, is a different rule and keeps the name. Cloud of Flies does what the shared special of that name does, under another name: it is kept apart.
Plague Monks have no maximum ("any number"). Plague Rats and Skaven Slaves gain no experience.

Our catalogue already holds a Skaven of Clan Pestilens template, the Mordheim 1b warband's, and a template is kept by its name, so this one is named Skaven of Clan Pestilens (Mousillon). Its warband type is named Skaven of Clan Pestilens, as the PDF names it.
Page 7 holds only the Skaven Slave's Abused rule; the measured scan page carries nothing else.
